# #3418: CI: a patches promotion or log is stuck
Opened by @github-actions[bot].

<!-- stuck #3415 -->
The card-patch promotion https://github.com/Jlore-Studios/JackiOh/pull/3415 (`patches ship`, R646) has been open over 2 hours and did not merge itself:

- [web (unit 7/8)](https://github.com/Jlore-Studios/JackiOh/actions/runs/42407758136/job/128512330727)
- [web](https://github.com/Jlore-Studios/JackiOh/actions/runs/42407758136/job/128516242639)

Until it merges, the patches it ships are not live as versions: `CATALOG_VERSION` stays where it was and the patch notes do not show them.

Fix it on a branch from main: a check that only fails here usually reads the shipped history (`crates/cards/patches/`) and must hold for the history this promotion ships, so check out its branch and run the failing tests there to see it fail first, then show them pass there with the fix. A conflict alone needs no fix. Close this issue with the fix's pull request (or, for a conflict alone, by hand); the watch in `.github/workflows/patches-ship.yml` then ships again from the newer main, and that promotion supersedes this one.

If they are red for a reason outside the repository (CI out of minutes, a spending limit, billing, an account, a runner that never started), no change here fixes it: open the plan with a `**Human required:**` line saying what a person must do, and build nothing.

## Plan

_Written by `claude-2` (claude, `opus`, strong) ([run](https://github.com/Jlore-Studios/JackiOh/actions/runs/42420507196)) before anyone built this. The night bot's builder starts from this section: edit it here to change the plan._

The red doesn't happen again on the exact history the promotion ships, so I found no change in the repository that fixes it. Then either press "Re-run failed jobs" on that run (once green, #3415 merges itself), or close #3418 by hand. Closing it lets the watch in `.github/workflows/patches-ship.yml` ship again from the newer main (03e0cbaf9d or later) and supersede #3415. Promotion #3415 (`patches ship: v0.5.12l, v0.5.12m, v0.5.12n, v0.5.12o`, branch `patches/ship-a3bc9af756`, commit 62c64e7881) merges, or a newer promotion supersedes it. ## What was checked (2026-11-07, 22:30–23:10 UTC)

This machine matches GitHub's `ubuntu-latest`: UTC, Node 24.19.0 (`.nvmrc`), 4 cores, 16 GB.

1. **The rebuilt promotion is identical to #3415.** `cargo jackioh patches ship` in a scratch worktree at main 03e0cbaf9d shipped v0.5.12l to v0.5.12o.    - The files Vitest actually ran for `--shard=7/8` were exactly those 63.
   - Four of them read the patch history: `apps/web/src/patches/github.test.ts`, `apps/web/src/replay/download.test.ts`, `apps/web/src/replay/retcon-v05.test.ts` and `apps/web/src/cards/art/scene.test.ts`. Each runs in under 1.2 s.
3. **Shard 7/8 passes on every candidate tree.** I ran CI's exact command (below) with the shipped history in place and the web tree at three points. Every run was 63 files and 1196 tests passed, 0 failed:
   - main 03e0cbaf9d: 6 runs;
   - 0034744a53, main when the promotion was committed at 19:45: 1 run;
   - a3bc9af756, the promotion's base: 1 run.
4. **The whole web, edge and admin unit suite** on main plus the shipped history: 9061 tests passed. The one failure was a file my own checkout left behind (`apps/web/src/stats/TokensPanel.tsx`, which #3328 deletes). That test passed once the file was removed.
5. **Nothing points to a timing or environment cause:**
   - No shard-7 test comes near its time limit. The slowest are the `apps/web/src/net/ci-scope.test.ts` cases at about 1.5 s against Vitest's default 5 s, and the finale lessons at 8 s against 180 s. #3417's figures put CI at about 1.4× this machine.
   - No shard-7 test reads `CI`, `GITHUB_*` or the branch name.
   - The only shard-7 test that starts processes, `apps/web/src/net/ci-scope.test.ts`, builds its own temporary git repo.

Leave these alone:
- `.github/`, `.harness/`, `.squishy/` and `bot/`.
- `crates/cards/patches/`: the shipped history and the pending fragments (R646, R1280000).
- Every test's timeout or skip: no change without a log that shows the test timing out or failing.

2. If a step outside the tests failed (setup, the `web-build` artifact download, a lost or timed-out runner), or a test failed that passes on a re-run: press "Re-run failed jobs" on run 42407758136, or close #3418 by hand. 3. If a test fails again:
   1. On a branch from main, run `cargo jackioh patches ship` and `sh scripts/build-wasm.sh`.
   2. Run `pnpm --dir apps/web exec vitest run <that file>` and confirm it fails.
   3. Reopen #3418 with the test's name and its failure message. The fix then follows the issue's own recipe: fail on the shipped history first, then pass there with the fix.

## Tests

No tests are added, since no change is planned. To repeat the check from a clean checkout of main:

```
git worktree add --detach /tmp/ship HEAD && cd /tmp/ship && pnpm install --frozen-lockfile
cargo jackioh patches ship && sh scripts/build-wasm.sh
pnpm exec vitest run --project web --project edge --project admin --shard=7/8 --exclude '**/src/audio/**' --exclude '**/src/fx/**' --exclude '**/src/cards/art/convention.test.ts' --exclude '**/src/net/promote-production.test.ts' --exclude '**/src/net/promote-staging.test.ts'
cd - && git worktree remove --force /tmp/ship
```

## Done when

- [ ] Someone has read job 128512330727's log and noted what failed on #3418.
- [ ] Either #3415 merged after a re-run, or #3418 is closed and a `patches ship` promotion from a newer main superseded #3415 and merged.
- [ ] That promotion's five required checks (`rust`, `web`, `e2e smoke`, `db`, `bot selftest`) were green.
- [ ] `CATALOG_VERSION` on main is v0.5.12o or later.

## Risks

- **A flaky shard-7 test could fail the next promotion too.** If so, that job's log names the test, and it gets its own issue with the failure quoted.
- **A guessed fix would weaken a check without evidence.** Raising a timeout or skipping a test breaks the night bot's "Never" rule 2, so none is planned.
- **Re-run or close, not both.** A re-run tests #3415's original merge commit, and a close re-ships from the newer main. Both ship the same four patches, because nothing under `pending/` changed since a3bc9af756.

## Open questions

- What does job 128512330727's log say failed? Only a person with access to the Actions logs can read it; the bot has no GitHub access.

Comment by @jgoetzmann at 2026-11-08T22:57:26Z:

@jgoetzmann-bot I read the logs the hand-off asked for. Both promotions failed on a test timing out, and a different test each time. Make both robust, then plan and build the fix.

**#3443**, `web (unit 4/8)` ([job 128843526761](https://github.com/Jlore-Studios/JackiOh/actions/runs/42516273353/job/128843526761)):
- `apps/web/src/patches/source.test.ts:77`, "R388 the real source reads crates/cards/patches/: the file's order, the index and every snapshot".
- Error: `Test timed out in 30000ms`. It is the only failure: 1 of 1234 tests, all 64 other files passed.
- **Why it grows.** The test loads every snapshot through Vite's JSON import (`import.meta.glob` in `source.ts`). The history is 134 snapshots totalling 64 MB, and each shipped version adds about another 0.5 MB. So the test slows with every patch, and a promotion run, which loads the most snapshots of all, is where it runs out of time.
- **Fix direction.** Per pull request, read a bounded set of snapshots:
  - the first six;
  - `v0.2.0b`, which the test counts;
  - the newest few, since promotions only append (R646);
  - the index prefix.

  Move the full sweep, this test and the "index lists … exactly the versions" test that relies on its cache, into the daily run (`apps/web/src/test/daily.ts`), with a `daily:` reason naming the cheaper per-PR test, as CLAUDE.md asks. Raising the timeout alone only delays the next failure.

**#3415**, `web (unit 7/8)` ([job 128512330727](https://github.com/Jlore-Studios/JackiOh/actions/runs/42407758136/job/128512330727)):
- `apps/web/src/net/ci-scope.test.ts:238`, "runs the db job only when what it tests against Postgres changed".
- Error: `Test timed out in 5000ms`. It was the only failure: 1 of 1196.
- **The cause.** That test makes git commits and runs `scripts/ci-scope.sh` three times for each of about 25 files, all under vitest's default 5-second limit, on a runner spawning 63 workers.
- **Fix direction.** Make it cheaper, for example by answering each file once or batching the files into one script run. Or give it an explicit timeout sized to its work, as `source.test.ts` has.

Neither failure needs anything outside the repository. Once the fix merges, close this issue so `patches-ship.yml` ships again from the newer `main`, and that promotion supersedes #3443.
